title: Vibe

empty.title: No pinned conversations
empty.body: A pinned conversation appears here. Pin one from the sidebar's row menu, or press the add key once the panel has one.

menu.title: Panel menu
menu.layoutHint: Left and right change it; automatic follows the window
menu.removeHint: This unpins the conversation, here and in the sidebar
menu.approvalHint: Applies to every conversation, not just this cell
menu.panelHint: Automatic follows the window; pinned stays for this conversation
menu.addHint: Adding pins it: it appears here and in the sidebar's pinned section

add.title: Add a conversation
add.empty: Nothing here can be added. Every conversation in this place is already pinned.
add.footer: Adding pins the conversation: it appears here and in the sidebar's pinned section.
add.newConversationHint: Opens the new-conversation screen and pins what you create

queue.held: The queued message stays queued: this conversation's box already has text

probe.title: Key check (read-only)
probe.hint: Press ⌥⇧K three times to close. Nothing here blocks a key.
probe.empty: Press any key, or a button on the remote.

panel.pin: Pin the right column for this conversation

fullscreenFailed: Full screen was refused — see the console for the reason
